sentences.text: A UCB must not levy any charges or fees retrospectively at the time of pre-payment of loans that were waived off earlier by the UCB. [type:fact]

This rule is stated in the chapter on pre-payment charges for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, so I cannot confirm it applies here without the sanction date. [type:fact]
The directions also say that charges for account closure, if any, are a separate disclosed service charge, but the evidence does not show that this is the same fee as the waived loan fee. [type:fact]
